scispace.query: How should epistemic uncertainty from repeated evaluations of the same learned value model be propagated in Monte Carlo tree search without treating correlated backups as independent evidence?
scispace.use: Discovery only. Returned E-MCTS 2022 and other prior work; final claims cross-checked against primary EMCTS 2025 and Sezener–Dayan 2020 sources. Not a systematic-review completeness claim.

first_evaluation.code: Clear[n]; r = 1/4 + 3/(4 n); v = FullSimplify[1/(1 + 1/r), Assumptions -> n > 0]; k = n/(n+1); q = FullSimplify[(1-k)^2 + k^2 r, Assumptions -> n > 0]; z = Sqrt[2] InverseErf[19/20]; {v, q, Limit[v,n->Infinity], Table[{m, N[v /. n->m,16], N[Erf[z Sqrt[(1/(n+1))/(2q)]] /. n->m,16]}, {m,{1,8,64,512,4096}}]}
